remarks:
Welcome to your dream home of effortless living! This stunning 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo offers the perfect blend of modern style and total convenience.

Step inside to a bright and spacious open-concept main floor that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen areas—an ideal setup for both relaxed daily living and entertaining guests. Upstairs, you will find three generously sized bedrooms, each offering ample closet space and beautiful natural light.

Love the outdoors? Open up your French doors from the living space to step directly onto your private deck, perfect for morning coffee, alfresco dining, or just soaking up the sun.

Best of all, you can say goodbye to weekend yard work. The care-free HOA completely covers all exterior maintenance, giving you more time to enjoy the things you love. Whether you are a first-time buyer, downsizing, or looking for a savvy investment, this move-in-ready condo is a must-see!

Sellers reserve the right to set an offer deadline.
